top5.title: New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65%
top5.summary: Hugging Face released Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted, an Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter trained with reinforcement learning for the pi coding agent. It lifts SWE-bench Pro hard-51 pass@1 from 39.2% to 64.7% and Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 39.5% to 55.8%. The post New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65% appeared first on MarkTechPost .
top5.title_zh: 新 LoRA 适配器将 Qwen3.8 编码成功率从 39% 提升至 65%
top5.summary_zh: Hugging Face 发布 Apache-2.0 许可的 Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted LoRA 适配器，针对 pi 编码代理用强化学习训练，SWE-bench Pro hard-51 pass@1 从 39.2% 升至 64.7%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 39.5% 升至 55.8%。
top5.why_it_matters_zh: 这表明轻量适配器可显著提升开源模型的编码代理表现。
top5.title_en: New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65%
top5.summary_en: Hugging Face released Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted, an Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter trained with reinforcement learning for the pi coding agent, lifting SWE-bench Pro hard-51 pass@1 from 39.2% to 64.7% and Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 39.5% to 55.8%.
top5.why_it_matters_en: It suggests lightweight adapters can substantially improve coding-agent performance on open models.
top5.what_zh: 据 MarkTechPost 报道，Hugging Face 发布 Apache-2.0 许可的 Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted LoRA 适配器，针对 pi 编码代理用强化学习训练；报道称 SWE-bench Pro hard-51 pass@1 从 39.2% 升至 64.7%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 39.5% 升至 55.8%。
top5.what_en: MarkTechPost reports Hugging Face released Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted, an Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter trained with reinforcement learning for the pi coding agent; it reports SWE-bench Pro hard-51 pass@1 rising from 39.2% to 64.7% and Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 39.5% to 55.8%.
top5.why_zh: 若数据成立，说明轻量适配器可显著提升开源模型的编码代理表现，降低构建编码代理的门槛。
top5.why_en: If the figures hold, lightweight adapters can meaningfully boost open-model coding-agent performance, lowering the barrier to building coding agents.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这些是发布方自报的基准结果，尚非独立评测；提升幅度大，值得复现验证后再采信。
top5.editor_judgment_en: These are self-reported benchmarks, not independent evaluations; the large gains warrant reproduction before being treated as established.
